In the first quadrant of ℂ C ⁡ ( z ) has an infinite set of zeros z n = x n + i ⁢ y n , n = 1 , 2 , 3 , … , arranged in order of increasing absolute value. Similarly for S ⁡ ( z ) . Let z n be a zero of one of the Fresnel integrals. Then − z n , z ¯ n , − z ¯ n , i ⁢ z n , − i ⁢ z n , i ⁢ z ¯ n , − i ⁢ z ¯ n are also zeros of the same integral. Tables 7.13.3 and 7.13.4 give 10D values of the first five x n and y n of C ⁡ ( z ) and S ⁡ ( z ) , respectively.
